artifacts.summary: Verdict-first report settling Q1 (Saturation proved for both witness frames; both now FrameOver.IsRegular), Q2 (R0 fails without Limit, via a new ghost-ray witness replacing the unverified modified-hedgehog sketch), Q3.2 (metric frame: cone-neighbourhood and final topologies coincide), plus the rational-carrier non-Saturation contrast and a new certified obstruction for Q3.1.
Sorry-free Saturation for the two-origin half-line via the band normal form and the shadow map; frame.IsRegular instance; taskFrame_t1_not_t2.
Sorry-free Saturation for the hedgehog, one ray at a time via common_ray; frame.IsRegular instance.
Sorry-free witness that the cone-neighbourhood topology need not be R0 once Limit is dropped (Seriality and Compositionality hold).
Sorry-free proof that the rational-carrier two-origin relation satisfies Seriality, Compositionality and Limit but fails Saturation.
Sorry-free proof that on the metric frame the cone-neighbourhood topology equals the final topology of all histories, plus the general surjective-open-history criterion.
The extractable general lemma: a directed family of nonempty sets with compact closed images under a map has a common image point.
